$comment: EXP-1249: the composer's ONE '+' menu, byte-identical x4 (web components/launch-dialog/composer-menu.ts, desktop chat_screen.rs + launch_options.rs, iOS AgentComposerCard.swift, Android AgentComposer.kt). The '+' is the composer's ONLY tool (the Issue and Action tools and the options line's '...' overflow are gone; #EXP-1434 owner 2026-10-29 AMENDS NEW-2: 'an entry for prompts would be good, such that you dont have to type "/" necessarily': the team's prompts are ALSO the `prompts` row here, the `/` menu keeps them too); md+ = a dropdown anchored at the '+', phones = a bottom sheet of the same rows, submenus as pushed pages. Rows in `rows` order; a row with `when` renders only while that condition holds (`conditions` says when), then separators are TIDIED (never leading, trailing or doubled). Icons are CONCEPTS (packages/icons/icons.json). Submenus (SLOP-28, EXP-1259 D5): implement-issue is, the shared search list (search-list.json: a search input on top, Picker rows of ONE height `submenuRowHeight`, the list scrolls, at most `submenuMaxRows` rows visible, bottom fade); on a pointer they open to the side on hover or Right arrow (Left/Escape closes back to the parent), on phones they push as pages. implement-issue = issue rows (status glyph, mono identifier, title; the picks pinned first, checkmarks) with a footer button `implementButton` once something is picked (it only closes the menu: the picks are already the subject); effort = picker rows over the agent's efforts, value = the picked effort's label, label `codexLabel` for codex, DISABLED while ultracode is on; (#EXP-1734, EDE-63 owner 2026-11-07: the Subagents row is GONE ×4, subagents run on the session's own model, opus by default); mcp-servers = multi picker rows over the team's servers (a server the caller has not connected opens Settings > MCP servers instead of toggling), value = the number picked (no value at zero); skills (#EXP-1655, skills.json `menuRow`) = the same multi picker rows over the team's skills (name, caption = description), value = the number picked (no value at zero). add-file ('Photo or file') opens the platform file chooser with NO type filter (any file: images up to 10 MB keep their [Image #N] marker, other files up to 50 MB ride as file links, 4 of each). EXP-1635 (owner 2026-11-04): on a PHONE (iOS, Android, web-mobile) add-file opens the `addFile.phoneChoices` sub-choice, the same GlassMenu look ×3 (iOS's former two-entry Photo | File grown by Camera): `camera` (the system camera, one shot; only on a device that has one), `photos` (the system photo picker, MANY at once), `file` (the file chooser, any type, MANY at once). On a pointer (web md+, the IDE) add-file stays the file chooser directly, MANY at once. A pick beyond the caps keeps the composer's own toast. S-3 (owner 2026-10-28, mobile is the reference): EVERY composer ×4 (the launch composer, a session's, an agent chat's: `surface` launch | session | agent) has ONLY the '+' as its tool: NO options line under the card (Device, Account, Model and Repository are + rows now), NO inline image/file/#/emoji/mention buttons (emoji stays only in the issue comment composer). A row's `surfaces` = where it exists; `when` (one condition or a list, all must hold) = when it shows. Rows: add-file 'Photo or file' (iOS keeps its Photo | File sub-choice), implement-issue 'Issue' (launch: the implement subject picker; session/agent: THE same issue search list, a pick inserts `#IDENT` at the caret), a separator, then the RUNNER submenus over THE existing pickers as submenu rows (search-list.json; value = the picked label): device (picker-device), account (picker-account), model (ModelPicker), repository (picker-repository, only while the team has `repositories` > 1), each only where it can change (`device`/`account`/`model` conditions: the launch composer while the agent row picks `Temporary session`; a session's model while it runs on a model-switching agent; an agent chat's model; a running session never moves device here; the one session surface that shows Device is an app editor's, apps.json EDITOR DEVICE). #EXP-1535 (owner 2026-11-01, x4 the same): Account › sits on EVERY composer: the launch composer (a new chat: the login it starts on) AND a session's or an agent chat's (the login its NEXT turn runs on) while the session's device is online and the viewer `canSteerSession`; NO new mechanism and NO new UI: the rows are THE AccountPicker rows (health hint + the usage preview below), the current login checked, and a session pick IS the usage wall's existing switch (`sessions.send {sessionId, account}`, no text, the device resumes the SAME session on that login between turns) under its existing rules (web lib/session-account-switch.ts, mirrored x4): only the session's agent's logins; a run-level refusal (not claude, offline, busy) or a login's own (signed out, needs re-login, already on it) DISABLES the row and never hides the submenu. On launch the WORK picks follow (effort, ultracode, MCP servers, computer use) only for a temporary session (`temporary`): a message to an agent runs on that agent's definition. #EXP-1793 (owner 2026-11-12: 'agent settings need also mcps please. (also in their composer + menu)'): an agent chat ALSO gets `mcp-servers` (`mcpPick`), THE same multi picker rows as the launch composer's, its pick = the conversation's servers (seed: `sessions.mcpPicks` of the conversation, none yet = the agent's `mcpServerIds`, agent-settings.json `mcpRow`); a send carries `mcpServerIds` whenever the pick differs from that seed (an empty pick clears). The old `message-agent` row and its agent chip are GONE: the composer-home.json agent row picks the recipient. EXP-1345 picker rule ×4 (owner 2026-10-17): a single-select pick is THE Picker (selected row's ui-check TRAILING; md+ = a popover at the trigger, phones = a bottom sheet of the same rows); action menus (context menus, the '+') stay THE Menu. The Agent page draws NO suggestion rows and NO brand-mark watermark (composer-home.json owns the page around the card). The options line's Resume pill is GONE with it ×4 (owner 2026-10-28): no + row; a send uses the stored resume default (on). #EXP-1434 (owner 2026-10-29, ×4 the same): PROMPTS row `prompts` ('Prompts', the concept `coding-command`, every surface, while the team has a prompt: `prompts`) right after Issue = THE search list (search-list.json) over the team's prompts in the `/` menu's order (row = the prompt's own icon in the default muted tint, as the `/` menu draws it (prompts carry no colour), + its name; the input filters by name like the `/` filter); a pick does EXACTLY what picking it in the `/` menu does (a session/agent composer inserts its body into the draft at the caret; the launch composer makes it the new session's subject) and closes the menu. ACCOUNT LIMITS: the account submenu's rows carry THE EXP-992 usage preview of picker-account (`AccountPicker`, `accountLimitWindows`: the 5h, week and model windows as UsageWindows density `hover`): on a pointer a hover card beside the hovered row, on touch the bars inline under the row's label; a login with no `limits` shows none.

conditions.temporary: launch: the agent row (composer-home.json `agentRow`) picks Temporary session (no agent)
conditions.device: the device can change here: launch while temporary; an app editor's composer (#FEED-204, apps.json EDITOR DEVICE: its row reads the device, disabled while the editor root is live); never in any other session or an agent chat
conditions.account: the login can change here: launch while temporary; an app editor's composer, always (#EXP-1729, apps.json `editorHeader`: no root or an ended root = the pick rides the next send; a live root = the session account switch); a session or an agent chat while its device is online and the viewer canSteerSession (the pick = the session account switch)
conditions.model: the model can change here: launch while temporary; an app editor's composer, always (#EXP-1729: no root or an ended root = the pick rides the next send; a live root = the session's model switch); a session or an agent chat whose agent switches models (always for claude and codex)
conditions.repositories: the team has more than one repository
conditions.mcp: the team has at least one MCP server
conditions.mcpPick: the MCP servers pick can change here (#EXP-1793): launch while temporary; an agent chat, always (its conversation's pick, seeded from `sessions.mcpPicks`, else the agent's `mcpServerIds`; a pick rides the next send as `mcpServerIds`)
conditions.skills: the team has at least one skill (skills.json `menuRow`)
conditions.computerUse: the picked device advertises the `computerUse.cap` capability
conditions.prompts: the team has at least one prompt (the `/` menu lists it)
conditions.assistant: the message goes to the viewer's Assistant (launch: the agent row picks it; agent: its chat)
conditions.teams: the viewer belongs to more than one team

computerUse.$comment: Per-run computer use. The start payload key sits next to `mcpServerIds` in steer.startSession, codingSessions.start and the relay's start frame; true/false = this run, absent or null = the device's launch_defaults.computerUse. The toggle seeds from that device default on every device change and rides out only to a device advertising `cap` (older builds would ignore it).

teamsPick.$comment: #EXP-1715 (owner 2026-11-06, ×4 the same): the Assistant's TEAMS pick, which teams a turn may touch (server: sessions.send `scopeTeamIds`, emcp access.json `assistantScope`). The `teams` row = THE search list (search-list.json) of MULTI picker rows over the teams the viewer belongs to, in their team switcher order: the team's own avatar (the switcher's team image or initials) + its name, the check TRAILING. Nothing picked yet = EVERY team (null; all rows checked); unchecking narrows the pick; the last checked team cannot be unchecked; checking every team again = null. The row's value = `teamsPickValue`. While the pick is a SUBSET, the picked teams ride as CHIPS in the composer's chip row (THE removable pill chip the composer's prompt subject uses: the team avatar + its name + the remove ×); removing a chip unchecks it, removing the last one = every team again. The pick is the next send's `scopeTeamIds` (null = every team) and every later turn's until changed; the composer seeds it from the conversation root's synced `scope_team_ids` (null = every team).
